detail.statement: Current automated meta-reasoning frameworks operate strictly within fixed methodological parameters and lack the reflexive capacity to autonomously revise their foundational epistemic assumptions or procedural definitions without external intervention, while auxiliary human domains show dependencies when interacting with automated recommendations.
detail.reason: Re-evaluating the belief against newly incorporated evidence confirms that automated architectures continue to operate within bounded parametric definitions.
